Vegan food to perfection
Sep 2026 • Couples
Incredibly delicious vegan food. The service was super friendly and spoke excellent English. The first time we were so convinced that we wanted to come back the next day. Our expectations were exceeded again on the second day. The food tastes fresh, spices are well balanced, and there is a pleasant atmosphere. Sometimes you would like to give 6/5 stars. My personal recommendation is the sandwich with tofu, caramelized onions, and smoked carrots. A complete explosion of flavor. We were so convinced by the food that we skipped drinks to be able to try one more dish. (There is free water).
More than an absolute recommendation, rather a must to have eaten here once.
